$comment: Every string of the analytics screens (PEN-137): consent, Settings → Privacy, Advanced, the viewer, the confirmations and Send Feedback’s logs box, as the Mac says it and as the phone does, `{device}` filled in; other `{name}`s are filled in by the client. Keys in `titleKeys` are Title Case (A938). Written and checked from packages/core/src/analytics/copy.ts by packages/core/test/analytics-copy.test.ts; read by the Kotlin AnalyticsCopyContractTest.

consent.body.mac: Penmoss keeps a record of what you do in it, by name, on this Mac, and Settings → Privacy shows it. Share Usage Data sends it, this setup included, to Penmoss’s developer. Don’t Share keeps it on this Mac.
consent.body.android: Penmoss keeps a record of what you do in it, by name, on this phone, and Settings → Privacy shows it. Share Usage Data sends it, this setup included, to Penmoss’s developer. Don’t Share keeps it on this phone.

consent.recorded.1.mac: The commands, shortcuts, buttons and menus you use, by name
consent.recorded.1.android: The commands, shortcuts, buttons and menus you use, by name

consent.recorded.2.mac: The screens and dialogs you open, and the settings you change
consent.recorded.2.android: The screens and dialogs you open, and the settings you change

consent.recorded.3.mac: The app’s and the system’s versions, the window’s size and layout, and how far you scroll
consent.recorded.3.android: The app’s and the system’s versions, the window’s size and layout, and how far you scroll

consent.recorded.4.mac: CLI commands and agents’ MCP calls, by name

consent.never.1.mac: What you write: notes, titles, tags, links and searches
consent.never.1.android: What you write: notes, titles, tags, links and searches

consent.never.2.mac: The names of notebooks, folders, files and repositories
consent.never.2.android: The names of notebooks, folders, files and repositories

consent.never.3.mac: Your GitHub account, email address or tokens
consent.never.3.android: Your GitHub account, email address or tokens

consent.later.mac: You can change this at any time in Settings → Privacy, and see what is recorded there.
consent.later.android: You can change this at any time in Settings → Privacy, and see what is recorded there.

privacy.lead.mac: Penmoss records what you do in it, by name, on this Mac, and never anything you write or name.
privacy.lead.android: Penmoss records what you do in it, by name, on this phone, and never anything you write or name.

privacy.share.hint.mac: Sends the record to Penmoss’s developer from now on. Off, it stays on this Mac.
privacy.share.hint.android: Sends the record to Penmoss’s developer from now on. Off, it stays on this phone.

privacy.id.hint.mac: A random ID you can reset. It says nothing about you.
privacy.id.hint.android: A random ID you can reset. It says nothing about you.

privacy.resetId.done.mac: A new ID is in use. Events not yet sent stay on this Mac.
privacy.resetId.done.android: A new ID is in use. Events not yet sent stay on this phone.

privacy.logs.hint.mac: The last {days} days, on this Mac. They leave only when you attach them to a bug report.
privacy.logs.hint.android: The last {days} days, on this phone. They leave only when you attach them to a bug report or share them.

privacy.advanced.hint.mac: How long and how much Penmoss keeps on this Mac
privacy.advanced.hint.android: How long and how much Penmoss keeps on this phone

privacy.advanced.intro.mac: How much Penmoss keeps on this Mac. Lowering a limit asks first, then deletes what falls outside it.
privacy.advanced.intro.android: How much Penmoss keeps on this phone. Lowering a limit asks first, then deletes what falls outside it.

limits.usage.space.mac: About {size} of events at most on this Mac
limits.usage.space.android: About {size} of events at most on this phone

limits.logs.space.mac: Up to {size} of logs on this Mac (at most 400 MB)
limits.logs.space.android: Up to {size} of logs on this phone (at most 400 MB)

limits.report.space.mac: A bug report attaches the last {hours} hours, at most {lines} lines and {kb} KB.
limits.report.space.android: A bug report attaches the last {hours} hours, at most {lines} lines and {kb} KB.

limits.reset.hint.mac: Or run penmoss analytics limits in a terminal.

forget.body.mac: Penmoss’s server deletes everything this Mac shared under ID {id}, and this Mac gets a new ID. The record on this Mac stays.
forget.body.android: Penmoss’s server deletes everything this phone shared under ID {id}, and this phone gets a new ID. The record on this phone stays.

forget.offline.mac: You’re offline, so nothing was deleted. Try again when you’re online.
forget.offline.android: You’re offline, so nothing was deleted. Try again when you’re online.

forget.failed.mac: Penmoss’s server didn’t answer, so nothing was deleted. Try again later.
forget.failed.android: Penmoss’s server didn’t answer, so nothing was deleted. Try again later.

forget.done.mac: Your shared data was deleted, and this Mac has a new ID.
forget.done.android: Your shared data was deleted, and this phone has a new ID.

prune.body.mac: They’re {reason}. They’re deleted from this Mac now, and raising the limit later won’t bring them back.
prune.body.android: They’re {reason}. They’re deleted from this phone now, and raising the limit later won’t bring them back.

viewer.summary.mac: On this Mac, kept {days} days. ID {id}. {sharing}
viewer.summary.android: On this phone, kept {days} days. ID {id}. {sharing}

feedback.logs.hint.mac: The app’s logs from the last {hours} hours, at most {maxLines} lines and {kb} KB, with names, paths, IDs and secrets replaced. This is exactly what is attached.
feedback.logs.hint.android: The app’s logs from the last {hours} hours, at most {maxLines} lines and {kb} KB, with names, paths, IDs and secrets replaced. This is exactly what is attached.

feedback.logs.empty.mac: There are no logs from the last {hours} hours.
feedback.logs.empty.android: There are no logs from the last {hours} hours.
